# Omnimo vs Genie

Updated November 25, 2026 · prices from the US App Store

Genie, listed as "Chatbot AI Assistant – Genie" by AppNation, has 204,000 ratings on the US App Store. Like Omnimo it brings models from several makers together; it puts more weight on research and image tools.

Omnimo: the app's App Store listing and its pricing (US). Genie (Chatbot AI Assistant): its App Store listing and list of in-app purchases, US storefront, read 25 November 2026. Prices in other countries differ.

## Where Genie is better

Genie has Deep Thinking for hard problems, Deep Search reports, image generation and editing, and voice chat, plus a long track record and Family Sharing. Its listing names more image and video models than Omnimo has.

## Where Omnimo is better

Omnimo has Apple Intelligence free and offline on the device, reads your documents on the device, needs no account. It names each model so you know which one is answering. Pro has a $9.99 monthly plan as well as $6.99 a week and $39.99 a year.

## The honest verdict

**Choose Genie** if you want deep-search reports and an image editor built around chat.

**Choose Omnimo** if you want to pick each model by name and a free on-device model.

Both are free to try: [Genie on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1658377526) and [Omnimo on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891). Omnimo is made by the team that writes this site, so weigh this page accordingly; we have tried to say where Genie wins.

## Questions

### Which models does Genie use?

Its listing names GPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, DeepSeek, Perplexity Sonar, Kimi and GLM, plus image and video models. Omnimo offers GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and MiniMax.

### How much does Genie cost?

Its in-app purchases include Weekly Unlimited at $7.99, other weekly plans from $8.99 to $12.99 and yearly plans at $39.99 and $99.99 (25 November 2026). Omnimo Pro is $6.99 a week, $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year in the US.

### Does Omnimo work offline?

Apple Intelligence does, on supported devices and languages. The cloud models need the internet.
